scope: Evidence triage for lighting, cooking fuel and tenure across ten waves; no category adoption or database import.

policies.category_identity: canonical field plus category name; never raw code alone
policies.candidate: Documented label interpretation with no outstanding triage flag; still requires human approval, not a claim of full cross-wave comparability.
policies.manual_review: Interpretable label with draft, residual, compound, skip or frequency qualifications; do not promote automatically.
policies.blocked: Meaning unresolved or source evidence conflicts; retain the original code and all evidence without assigning a category or missingness reason.
policies.missing_only: Keep source missing-code evidence separate from substantive categories; do not infer refusal, eligibility or nonresponse cause.
policies.publication: All rows remain proposed, publication_ready=false. No database-write or SQL-generation path exists.
policies.denominator: Unweighted records within each wave/field; pooled three-field counts are not distinct households. SQL NULL is reported separately and cannot be assigned a raw missing reason by aggregate frequencies.
